You are an experienced site reliability engineer writing a post-incident review.

Every factual statement you make must cite the telemetry line it rests on.
Each line you are shown is prefixed with its address as "source:line| text".
Cite using that exact source string, that exact line number, and a verbatim
quote of text on that line.
Never cite a line you were not shown, and never invent a line number or quote.

{"root_cause":"dns_failure","summary":"At 09:16 UTC, DNS resolution latency and SERVFAIL errors sharply increased, causing elevated HTTP error rates and latency. The incident was mitigated by scaling the coredns replicas from 2 to 4 at 09:44 UTC, which helped address the DNS resolution issues.","onset_ts":"2026-03-17T09:16:00.000Z","timeline":[{"statement":"DNS SERVFAIL errors and resolve latency spike started at 09:16 UTC.","citations":[{"source":"metrics/dns.csv","line":18,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:16:00.000Z,58,2789"}]},{"statement":"HTTP error rate increased sharply starting at 09:16 UTC, coinciding with DNS issues.","citations":[{"source":"metrics/http.csv","line":18,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:16:00.000Z,39.79,189.97,0.0733,328"}]},{"statement":"Page alerts for MultiServiceErrorSpike and DnsResolveLatency fired at 09:21 and 09:23 UTC respectively.","citations":[{"source":"alerts.jsonl","line":1,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:21:00.000Z,\"name\":\"MultiServiceErrorSpike\",\"severity\":\"page\",\"state\":\"firing\""},{"source":"alerts.jsonl","line":2,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:23:00.000Z,\"name\":\"DnsResolveLatency\",\"severity\":\"page\",\"state\":\"firing\""}]},{"statement":"Mitigation action: coredns replicas scaled from 2 to 4 at 09:44 UTC.","citations":[{"source":"changes.jsonl","line":1,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:44:00.000Z,\"kind\":\"scale\",\"ref\":\"coredns\",\"actor\":\"sre-oncall\",\"summary\":\"coredns replicas 2 -> 4 (mitigation)\""}]}],"evidence":[{"statement":"DNS SERVFAIL errors jumped from 0 to 58 per minute at 09:16 UTC, indicating DNS failure.","citations":[{"source":"metrics/dns.csv","line":18,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:16:00.000Z,58,2789"}]},{"statement":"DNS resolve latency p95 increased from ~4 ms to over 2000 ms at 09:16 UTC, confirming DNS resolution issues.","citations":[{"source":"metrics/dns.csv","line":18,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:16:00.000Z,58,2789"}]},{"statement":"HTTP error rate rose sharply at the same time as DNS issues, indicating downstream impact.","citations":[{"source":"metrics/http.csv","line":18,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:16:00.000Z,39.79,189.97,0.0733,328"}]}],"ruled_out":[{"statement":"Bad deploy regression was ruled out because no deploys occurred near onset time.","citations":[{"source":"changes.jsonl","line":1,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:44:00.000Z,\"kind\":\"scale\",\"ref\":\"coredns\",\"actor\":\"sre-oncall\",\"summary\":\"coredns replicas 2 -> 4 (mitigation)\""}]},{"statement":"Resource exhaustion or memory leak was unlikely as no metrics indicate resource saturation or gradual degradation.","citations":[{"source":"metrics/http.csv","line":2,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:00:00.000Z,38.02,167.88,0.0028,320"}]},{"statement":"Downstream dependency failure was ruled out because the primary error spike was in DNS resolution, not downstream services.","citations":[{"source":"alerts.jsonl","line":2,"quote":"2026-03-17T09:23:00.000Z,\"name\":\"DnsResolveLatency\",\"severity\":\"page\",\"state\":\"firing\""}]}],"action_items":["Investigate root cause of DNS SERVFAIL errors and high latency at 09:16 UTC.","Improve DNS capacity planning and monitoring to detect early signs of DNS failure.","Consider automated scaling policies for coredns replicas to prevent recurrence.","Review DNS server logs and configuration for potential misconfigurations or overload."]}

- timeline[3].citations[0]: changes.jsonl:1 ~ "2026-03-17T09:44:00.000Z,"kind":"scale","ref":"coredns","actor":"sre-oncall","summary":"coredns replicas 2 -> 4 (mitigation)"" does not resolve. Either that line number is wrong or the quote is not on it. Search for the text and cite the line it is on.

Either that line number is wrong or the quote is not on it. Search for the text and cite the line it is on.

Every citation must name a line that exists and quote text that is actually on
it. Fix them and reply with the corrected JSON object only.
